events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled "The Beatles", was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double LP, a double dose of genius, and still sparking debates about its best tracks. What's your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we said goodbye to the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his sheer artistry – truly one of a kind. Still rocking the airwaves.

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' hit the shelves. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution. Still sounds fresh as a daisy.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, musician and peace activist John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent for John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally. Forever missed.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself and his sound. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. Still an absolute icon, still influencing generations. Long live rock and roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! Led Zeppelin's guitar maestro, responsible for some of the most iconic riffs in history. Still got it.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Rod Stewart is 82 today! What a career, what a voice. Still touring, still a legend. Happy Birthday, Rod!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs, the iconic voice of Madness! Still bringing the house down with those ska classics. One step beyond!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that smooth voice we all fell in love with in the 80s. A true legend.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, businesswoman, and philanthropist Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Dolly Parton turns 81 today! A true icon of music, business, and pure joy. Here's to more '9 to 5' energy!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop superstar to West End composer, he's done it all. What's your favourite Take That track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinbagonian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and onto the radio! Still sounding incredible.

events.title: Rock Hall of Fame's first ceremony turns 38
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and The Beatles, took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction. A momentous day for music history, celebrating the very best. Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Always bringing that infectious energy to the stage. Still looking good after all these years.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final gig. What a way to go out! Still giving us chills.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo stardom, his drumming and vocals are unmistakable. Still a force of nature.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British charmer, Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to dramatic turns, he's always a joy to watch. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former *NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years on
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: Day The Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their legacy lives on through their timeless music. Forever remembered.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Never gonna give him up, never gonna let him down. Still a total legend.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The legendary Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to inspire the world. One love.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Iconic singer-songwriter Carole King, known for 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting legend whose music has touched millions. Still 'Tapestry'-ing our hearts.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: On this day in 2012, the world mourned the loss of pop and R&B icon Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years ago today, we lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston. Her music continues to inspire and move us. Forever missed, forever loved.

events.title: Take That's original split: 31 years on
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That famously announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago today, the world of pop stood still as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back and better than ever! What was your reaction back then?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the iconic voice of UB40! Still making us feel 'Red Red Wine' on the radio. Cheers, Ali!

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, he's truly conquered the world. What's your favourite Ed track?
